concerns.text: Plan and data-model designate `data/curated/filtered.csv` as the Single Source of Truth (Constitution Principle IV) and FR-008 explicitly requires baseline.py to read from it, but NO task produces `filtered.csv`. The pipeline instead produces `curated_clean.csv` → `engineered.csv` → `baseline_shifted.csv`. The declared SSoT artifact is orphaned; add a task (or amend T004) to emit the schema-conformant `filtered.csv`.

T003 writes `engineered.csv` 'without extra columns' and moves `electronegativity_diff`/`valence_electron_diff` to a separate `engineered_extra.csv`, but `dataset.schema.yaml` REQUIRES both fields in the curated dataset (required list) and T007 trains on all three feature columns from the engineered file. The schema-required columns have no task that writes them into the conformant curated dataset.

The spec edge case requiring an R² < 0.1 outcome to be flagged as 'Low Predictive Power - Null Result Hypothesis Supported' in the final report has no implementing task; T009's `validation_report.json` field list (`significance_verified`, `model_comparison`, `stability_target_met`) and T011's report description never include this flag.

T001 implements dual-mode (self + solute) extraction citing an 'amended FR-001 (see T015)', but the authoritative spec's FR-001 still mandates self-only filtering. T015 is sequenced first in the execution order, but the tasks document itself implements against a spec state that does not exist; the amendment must be a hard blocking gate or T001 must stay self-only until it lands.

concerns.text: Plan assigns FR-005/FR-009 to `code/validation/sensitivity_analysis.py`, but T008 builds `code/validation/stability_index_report.py`. The plan element has no task producing the named file; align the filename or update the plan.
T007 specifies '≥1000 bootstrap resamples' while the data model mandates 10,000 resamples with a percentile-inversion p-value procedure. The task under-covers the contract's specified procedure.
